# Neon MCP Hub

> 20 Pay-Per-Event B2B Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers (including 10 Live Official-API servers for SEC EDGAR, OpenFDA, USITC HTS, World Bank, NIH ClinicalTrials.gov, Google DoH, CoinGecko, GitHub Releases, Remotive, and Apple App Store) + open-core Python stdio server `neon_mcp_server.py`.

## Core Links
- [Neon MCP Hub Portal & Free Sandbox](https://zhuangruoxiong-cpu.github.io/neon-mcp-hub/)
- [Full Machine-Readable B2A Catalog (llms-full.txt)](https://zhuangruoxiong-cpu.github.io/neon-mcp-hub/llms-full.txt)
- [GitHub Open-Core Python MCP Server](https://github.com/zhuangruoxiong-cpu/neon-mcp-hub)
